title: acre reference panics when its output pipe closes early
body:
`acre reference` writes with `println!`, which panics when stdout closes before the output ends. Piping it into `head`, as in `acre reference row | head`, prints the first lines and then:

```text
thread 'main' panicked at library/std/src/io/stdio.rs:1166:9:
failed printing to stdout: Broken pipe (os error 32)
```

The listing itself is complete up to where `head` stops, so nothing is lost but the panic message and a non-zero exit.

## Proposal

Write the listing through a locked `stdout` with `writeln!`, and end quietly when a write fails with `ErrorKind::BrokenPipe`.
